summary:
Disputed by the supplier: GnuTLS does not enforce a permitted directoryName
name constraint on the end-entity subject. The CVE record notes that GnuTLS
does not consider this an actionable vulnerability, because its threat model
excludes attacks that need control of material inside the trust boundary
(trusted CAs and the certificates they issue). There is no upstream fix;
Debian rates it unimportant and leaves it unfixed in every suite.
